name: 德国专业技术人员工作签证
nameEn: Germany work visa for qualified professionals
summary: 面向资格已在德国获得认可或可比，并取得德国合格岗位邀请的专业人士。
summaryEn: For professionals with a qualification recognized or comparable in Germany and an offer of qualified employment.

qualification.summary: 学历或职业培训资格须在德国获得认可，或外国大学学历须与德国学历相当；受监管职业须有执业许可。
qualification.summaryEn: The academic or vocational qualification must be recognized in Germany, or a foreign degree comparable; regulated professions require permission to practise.

jobOffer.summary: 须有德国雇主提供的具体合格岗位；辅助性工作不符合。岗位通常不必与资格相关，但受监管职业例外。
jobOffer.summaryEn: A specific offer of qualified employment is required; auxiliary work does not qualify. The job generally need not relate to the qualification, except for regulated professions.

ageSalaryCondition.summary: 年满 45 岁且首次赴德工作者，2026 年税前年薪须至少 55,770 欧元，或证明有足够养老保障。
ageSalaryCondition.summaryEn: For first-time workers in Germany over 45, the 2026 salary must be at least €55,770 gross annually or adequate pension provision must be shown.

sources.authority: German Federal Government — Make it in Germany
sources.title: Work visa for qualified professionals

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
